capabilities.truth_boundary: Standalone Simics fixture TV-audio passthrough and receiver DMA suite; exported AuroraSim integration pending. Does not implement a TV OS, Netflix application, DRM or physical eARC discovery/signalling.
Standalone ideal 24-bit DAC and resistive-load model fed by actual Simics DMA output; exported AuroraSim integration pending. No vendor DAC, amplifier, acoustic model or physical speaker measurement.

Standalone Simics 7.84.0 vacuum harness passes 21 profiles including MMIO/DMA timing, full DSP PCM replay and MCHStreamer/UAC2 transport-contract checks. Export into AuroraSim capability mapping is still pending; no guest driver, vendor register accuracy or physical electrical timing is proven.

Software Gate A-Live now has bounded retained diagnostics, threshold-driven pass/fail verdicts and Linux/Windows self-tests for mid-stream acquisition and relock. Export into AuroraSim remains pending; physical live eARC capture, hardware reset/drop counters and electrical timing remain unproven.

Pinned Harletty JOC software is exercised through Aurora's hardware-neutral StreamingDecoder contract, explicit object-to-PCM-channel bindings, bounded priming/fault policy, bed routing, object gain rendering and speaker PCM mixing. Plain E-AC-3 is a fail-closed negative control. This is software-reference evidence only; it does not prove physical eARC capture, protected-service compatibility, final renderer quality, or Dolby certification.
Aurora currently has only an IAMF adapter placeholder; no decode/render proof is claimed.
Aurora has no proven Higher-Order Ambisonics scene-rendering lane; OAR supports scene-based elements up to fourth order and will be evaluated as an external reference.
EAR/libear differential reference lane is not yet implemented.
Binaural/head-tracking reference validation is not yet implemented; OAR/OBR/BEAR are candidate external oracles.
Aurora does not yet provide a codec-neutral authored audio-element/group timeline with bounded user personalization, deterministic mix presentations, and gain/position interpolation.

Aurora represents custom speaker geometry but has no proven end-to-end layout-negotiation, speaker-loss/degraded-layout, or automatic placement-adaptation policy comparable in product goal to flexible-layout systems.
Aurora output DSP has explicit headroom and a linked limiter, but no proven BS.1770/EBU-style loudness measurement/normalization layer.

Executable virtual evidence drives Aurora's real fixed-storage PPM estimator, slew-limited DriftController feed-forward and RubatoAsrc ratio/sample path for both +250 ppm and -250 ppm over a simulated 24 hours while keeping a fixed-capacity ring bounded. It also requires discontinuity to clear stale trust/feed-forward before reacquiring a reversed clock epoch and rejects an out-of-range 5000 ppm relationship fail-closed. This does not constitute physical clock measurement or prove a specific USB/TDM/audio device.

Executable virtual evidence drives Aurora's real DuplexStateMachine through 250/500/1000/2000/4000 ms bounded recovery backoff, successful late reappearance, stable-run history reset, fail-closed exhaustion after five failed attempts, and repeated successful-but-unstable reopen cycles that retain history until the recovery budget is exhausted. Backend reopen timing and physical device hotplug remain unproven.
No MIMO/SIMO multi-speaker low-frequency field-control optimizer has been implemented; synthetic-room validation would precede any acoustic claim.
Requires real hardware capture evidence under issue #143; no host, MCU, eARC bridge, or other hardware choice is fixed by the software architecture.
Virtual multichannel transport contracts do not prove any specific USB/TDM implementation, electrical timing, or clock behavior. Hardware remains intentionally unselected.
Requires a future selected output implementation and electrical/loopback measurement; Aurora software does not currently select a DAC architecture.
Synthetic measurement/calibration does not prove room response, bass field control, or multi-seat performance.
Legitimate protected-service compatibility must be tested separately without DRM circumvention.
Software, simulation, and physical prototype evidence do not constitute Dolby certification or conformance.
